name: Lodestone
author: Erin Carter
description: A dark liquid mirror: a broad pool rests low while an unseen magnetic lode patrols the upper dark. As it passes, the pool bulges into a teardrop, necks, and snaps a droplet free in a bright flash; when the halo wanes the droplet falls home and fuses back with a long settling wobble.

params.label: Pull
params.effect: Strength of the lode's attraction; near minimum the teardrop strains but pinch-off is a near miss, at maximum the droplet leaps free early.

params.label: Patrol speed
params.effect: How fast the unseen lode travels its arc, and therefore how often a droplet is taken.

params.label: Pool size
params.effect: Width scale of the resting pool in css pixels.

params.label: Halo
params.effect: Brightness of the faint marker halo on the attractor; at zero the lode is invisible and only the liquid betrays it.
